manifests.backend/pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "tandem-backend"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Tandem: multi-agent pipeline that finds where neighboring utilities plan to build close together"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.115",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30",
    "httpx>=0.27",
    "pydantic>=2.7",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0",
    "openpyxl>=3.1",
    "google-genai>=1.30",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2",
    "anthropic>=1.0",
    "openai>=2.0",
    "reportlab>=4.0",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest>=8", "pytest-asyncio>=0.23"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
asyncio_mode = "auto"

[tool.uv]
package = false

# CI-only tooling for the Azure test-generation pipeline (azure-pipelines.yml).
# Deliberately separate from pipeline/pyproject.toml, which is a frozen contract
# (specs/roadmap.md frozen_paths). These packages are never imported by product code.

manifests.pipeline/pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "gridbridge-pipeline"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
dependencies = [
    "pdfplumber",
    "openpyxl",
    "google-genai",
    "pymongo",
    "jsonschema",
    "pyyaml",
    "mongomock",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest", "pytest-xdist", "ruff"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# Only the bounded AlphaEarth COG sampling CLI needs GDAL/raster support.
environment = ["rasterio==1.5.1"]

[tool.uv]
package = false

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
# Tests live at the repo root (tests/golden, tests/pipeline); pipeline packages import as top-level modules.
pythonpath = ["."]
testpaths = ["../tests/golden", "../tests/pipeline"]
addopts = "--import-mode=importlib"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 130
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B", "UP"]
